semiconductor_relevance: High — NHK Spring specializes in precision components for semiconductor testing, including high-frequency test sockets and probes.
summary: NHK Spring (Taiwan) Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of precision testing components for the semiconductor industry, focusing on high-frequency compatible test sockets and advanced bonding technologies. Their products, including micro-probing contactors and high-durability plunger materials, are essential for intricate semiconductor testing processes.
